summary: Axos Bank, a subsidiary of Axos Financial, Inc., entered into a purchase and assumption agreement on April 22, 2026, to acquire individual retirement accounts (IRAs) from Capital One, National Association. The acquired IRAs have an aggregate balance of approximately $3.2 billion in savings and certificate of deposit accounts. Axos will pay cash for the deposit balance less a negotiated premium; specific price, premium, and advisors are not named. The acquisition requires approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and is expected to close later in 2026. This is a deposit portfolio acquisition, not a full bank merger. Watch for regulatory clearance as the key catalyst; no break fee or financing details disclosed.
